landings.name: Riverside Park kayak launch (Black Fork, Wally Rd)
Bridge of Dreams access (16606 Hunter Rd)

corrections.note: ODNR Mohican River Water Trail is 28 mi Class I (State Park to Kokosing confluence); mapped State Park->Brinkhaven run is 16.6 mi per ODNR (11.1 to Greer + 5.5 to Bridge of Dreams), not ~12. Clear Fork Gorge proper lies upstream of the SR 3 launch (below Pleasant Hill Dam) — livery run does not pass through it. Hazard: partially breached lowhead dam at Brinkhaven near Bridge of Dreams — dangerous at some levels; ODNR map says portage left. Loudonville Riverside Park launch under construction (breaking ground 2026).

landings.name: Fort Ancient Access (Little Miami State Park, SR 350)

corrections.note: National Wild & Scenic + state water trail. Corrected corridor Corwin->Milford is ~42 river mi per ODNR access-table mileages (Loveland->Milford ~11); no lowhead dams in this stretch (dams are upstream near Clifton/Xenia). Hazards: turbulence at Caesar Creek confluence during lake discharges; log jams/strainers. Morgan's Fort Ancient livery CLOSED Jan 2025 (land to Little Miami Conservancy/ODNR; access remains public; morgancanoe.com dead) — Loveland Canoe & Kayak and Little Miami Canoe Rental (Morrow) still serve the corridor.

Scioto Darby Road Access (Pickaway County Park District)

corrections.note: State & National Scenic River (scenic-river rules apply; not on ODNR water-trails list). No dams on the Prairie Oaks->Battelle Darby run; hazards are strainers/downed trees, flashy post-rain water, shallow riffles at low flow (Pickaway's Scioto Darby Rd access needs 150+ cfs, closed Nov-Apr). Metro Parks: Amity Rd to Battelle Darby canoe launch = 13 mi; Osprey Lake take-out adds ~5 mi. Trapper John's reopened May 2025 under new owners — only permitted commercial livery on Big Darby. Metro Parks pages publish addresses, not lat/lon, hence null coordinates.

landings.name: Kokosing Gap Canoe Access (Lower Gambier Rd)

corrections.note: Ohio's first designated water trail; full ODNR trail is 27.9 mi to the Mohican confluence. Mapped town order was wrong — true downstream order is Mount Vernon -> Gambier -> Howard -> Millwood; corrected Mount Vernon->Millwood run is 19.3 mi per ODNR segment table. Class I+ with shallow drags at low summer flow (ideal 100-200 cfs); strainers between Big Run and Pipesville; Factory Rapids below Millwood runs Class III at high water (stay left or portage right); no lowhead dams on mapped reach. Kokosing Valley Camp & Canoe (Howard) is the river's only canoe livery.

landings.name: St. Paris Pike Bridge Access (steep, river left)
SR 41 / First St Bridge (Snyder Park area)

corrections.note: ODNR water trail (2010); core run US-36 -> St. Paris Pike = ~9.6 mi (MCD river mi 45.8->36.2; SR-41/Snyder Park adds ~2.8). Hazards: 2-3 ft lowhead dam immediately below US-36 put-in (portage right); dam upstream near Lippincott Rd; cold spring-fed year-round trout water, swift narrow channel, frequent strainers. Major downstream dams (Huffman 73-ft, SR-444 millrace) lie outside this stretch. Birch Bark Canoe Livery (River Rd, Urbana) verified operating 2026.

landings.name: Beaver Creek SP at Echo Dell Rd (Gaston's Mill)

corrections.note: National + State Wild & Scenic. Class I-II; one II+ rapid below Fredericktown nears III at high water (AW). Remote roadless canyon through Beaver Creek SP/SF — limited road/cell access, self-rescue country; strainers on sharp bends. Rain/snowmelt dependent (spring and after storms). Lisbon lowhead dams (Willow Grove, US-30) sit above the Elkton put-in — none on the run. Respect private land at Fredericktown. Segments: Lusk Lock->Echo Dell 5.5 mi, Echo Dell->Fredericktown 7 mi, Fredericktown->Ohio River 8 mi, Elkton->Lusk ~3 mi = ~23 total.

extend_upstream.desc: Northampton Point River Access, 3132 Akron Peninsula Rd, Cuyahoga Falls (RM 36.7, opened Jul 2025) — Kent and Cleveland lie outside the CVNP stretch

extend_downstream.desc: Station Road Bridge River Access, Brecksville (RM 21)

corrections.note: Extent corrected: 'Kent->Peninsula->Cleveland ~15 mi' was wrong — Kent and Cleveland are outside CVNP. CVNP water-trail section is Northampton Point (RM 36.7) to Station Road Bridge (RM 21), ~16 mi; Lock 39 (RM ~9) adds a 12-mi Class I run toward Cleveland's shipping channel (freighters last 4 mi — advanced only). Brecksville diversion + Pinery feeder dams REMOVED 2020 (Station Rd free-flowing); Gorge Dam still stands upstream in Cuyahoga Falls; Class II-III gorge water is outside the park. Hazards: waterfall/dam remnant just above Lock 29 — portage river-left near SR 303; brief Class II at Peninsula; strainers throughout; log jams at pylons above Lock 39 (portage right); mandatory river-left take-out upstream of Fitzwater Rd (RM 17) per water-trail maps; avoid after heavy rain (sewer overflows). Burning River Adventures is based in Cuyahoga Falls (not Valley View) and mainly serves the Kent-Cuyahoga Falls section upstream of CVNP; site now operates as paddletheriver.com. NPS place pages confirm accesses but publish no lat/lon — those left null.

extend_downstream.desc: Beaty Landing, Painesville (RM 8.4); optional continue to Grand River Landing, Fairport Harbor (RM 2.7)

corrections.note: Put in BELOW the Harpersfield lowhead dam at the covered bridge — do not run it. Lake Metroparks water-trail river miles: Harpersfield (RM 31.0) to Beaty Landing (RM 8.4) = 22.6 mi, so mapped 12 mi was wrong; shorter day run Hidden Valley (RM 22.5) -> Beaty = 14.1 mi. Wild & Scenic lower gorge is a shale canyon. Log jams/strainers; flashy — gauge guide 2-5 ft optimal, under 2 ft slow drag, over 8 ft flood-dangerous; best flows spring/cold season.

landings.name: West Milton Municipal Park (Barefoot Canoe base)
Englewood MetroPark Canoe Take-out (above Englewood Dam)

corrections.note: State Scenic River; Stillwater Prairie->Englewood = ~14.2 mi (MCD river mi 37.5->23.3; Covington->Englewood alone 12.6). Dam-heavy: Covington waterworks dam (portage), rock dam 0.8 mi below Bridge St/SR-41 (portage right), dams below Falknor Rd and Fenner Rd (portage right), lowhead at West Milton water plant (SR-48), several dams Frederick-Garland->Old Springfield Rd (portage left). MANDATORY take-out at Englewood MetroPark above Englewood Dam (portage right; second dam below, portage left). Ludlow Falls (~15 ft) is on Ludlow Creek tributary, not the mainstem — avoid the creek mouth. Strainers common; upper reaches shallow late summer. Barefoot Canoe (West Milton) verified operating 2026.

landings.name: Indian Mill Park (below Indian Mill dam)
Wolf Creek Park canoe/kayak launch (north entrance)

corrections.note: Mapped extent was inconsistent: Upper Sandusky->Fremont is ~60+ river mi, not 12. Corrected core run: Wolf Creek Park (~RM 22-24) -> Rodger Young Park (RM 16-17), ~6-7 mi. Ballville Dam removed 2018 — free-flowing into Fremont; Sandusky Rapids below the old dam site run Class I-III depending on level (ODNR). Dams remain upstream: Upper Sandusky waterworks + Indian Mill (portage), Tiffin waterworks dam, Pioneer Mill dam, partial Huss St dam (portage/care). Flashy flows; heavy spring walleye-run angler crowds at Fremont. State Scenic River spans 65 mi, Harrison Smith Park to Rodger Young Park.
